01 一句話，怎麼寫出現實: 01　One sentence, and how it writes reality

會慢慢成為生活的一部分。: slowly become a part of life.

「越清楚的人力量越大，因為訊號越乾淨」: “The clearer a person is, the more power they have, because the signal is cleaner.”
我們相信，一個人的念頭和說出口的話，不只是描述眼前的生活，也可能一點一點影響生活: We believe a person's thoughts and spoken words do more than describe the life in front of them; they may also, little by little, shape where that life goes.
在我們的世界觀裡，這是一條從內在走向生活的路：頻率 → 語根 → 語句 → 現實: In our worldview, this is a path that runs from the inside out into life: Frequency → Root Code → Sentences → Reality. The Root Code is the soul's pronunciation, Frequency is the soul's tone of voice, and Reality is the full stop the soul writes.
這是我們理解世界的一種方式，不是已經被證實的定律。你可以認同，也可以有自己的看法: This is one way we understand the world, not a law that has been proven. You may agree, or you may see it your own way.
02 語根，本來是語言: 02　A Root Code was always language

例如，同樣是一件事沒做好，有人心裡先冒出「我又搞砸了」，有人想到的是「這次哪裡可: Say the same thing goes badly. One person's mind first says, “I messed up again.” Another thinks, “what can I adjust this time?” The event has not changed, but starting from those two sentences, the choices that follow may be different.

：怎麼跟自己說話，也可能影響當下的反應。實驗發現，用自己的名字跟自己說話，像是從: : How we talk to ourselves may also affect our reaction in the moment. In experiments, people who spoke to themselves using their own name, as if understanding themselves from an onlooker's point of view, were better able to stay steady under stress.

12 語根，是每個人身上都有的 12 種力量。每一種力量都有它珍貴的地方，但當某: The 12 Root Codes are 12 powers that everyone carries. Each has something precious in it, but when one power is used too much, the very sentence that was meant to protect us can make things harder and harder.
用過頭時：心裡可能會說「一定要照計畫來，不然會出事」。明明是想把事情做好，卻不知: when overused: your mind may say, “It has to follow the plan, or something will go wrong.” You only wanted to do things well, yet without noticing, you hold on tighter and tighter.
用過頭時：心裡可能會說「如果我不幫他，他怎麼辦」。很在乎別人，卻可能忘了自己也需: when overused: your mind may say, “If I do not help them, what will they do?” You care a great deal about others, yet may forget that you need care too.
用過頭時：心裡可能會說「沒關係，我還好」。習慣了撐住一切，有時連自己的感受也悄悄: when overused: your mind may say, “It is fine, I am okay.” Used to holding everything up, sometimes you quietly put your own feelings away too.
這三句話，你可能都曾經對自己說過。: You may have said all three of these sentences to yourself at one time or another.
我們不是要你否定原本的想法，也不是要你勉強自己變得正向。只是當你聽見那句熟悉的話: We are not asking you to reject your original thinking, nor to force yourself to be positive. It is only that when you hear that familiar sentence, you may get a chance to find that there can be another way to respond.
語根描述的是運作傾向，不是替人貼上的標籤，也可能隨著狀態改變。12 語根能否穩定: Root Codes describe tendencies in how we operate; they are not labels pinned on a person, and they may change with your state. Whether the 12 Root Codes can describe a person stably is still being validated.

不用急，慢慢來就好。: No rush. Taking it slowly is enough.
